leadText:
Samantha (Japanese: サヨリ Sayori) is a character of the day who appeared in Once in a Mawile when the group was traveling across Izabe Island.

She is a performer who does routines with ribbons. Samantha owns a that has many crushes, as it fell for 's . Lombre was uninterested, much to the dismay of Brock, who wanted to use the attraction to get closer to Samantha. After evolving into Ludicolo, it saw Mawile in a new light, but by that time, Mawile had already moved on to a .

For some reason, Samantha had a Water Stone in her backpack, which was what allowed Lombre to evolve.
